asset.name: Ethereum

score_rationales.institutional: Ethereum has deep institutional infrastructure with spot ETFs exceeding $16B AUM (BlackRock ETHA ~$6.5B, Fidelity FETH ~$4B), enterprise-grade custody from Coinbase Custody/BitGo/Fireblocks, and staking-yield ETF products launching in 2026 — but it trails BTC on corporate treasury adoption and overall ETF scale, keeping it below the top tier.
score_rationales.regulatory: ETH received explicit commodity classification from SEC/CFTC (March 2026), has live spot ETFs with staking amendments clearing by mid-2026, and benefits from MiCA coverage in the EU — the clearest multi-jurisdictional regulatory standing of any smart-contract platform. The remaining discount reflects pending US market structure legislation (CLARITY Act still in Senate) and UK licensing not fully operative until late 2027.
score_rationales.supply: ETH has no fixed supply cap but EIP-1559 fee burns have made net issuance effectively near-zero or deflationary during high-activity periods (~0.5% annualized issuance vs. burn offset), which is a meaningful structural tailwind. Approximately 28–30% of supply is staked on the Beacon Chain, materially reducing liquid float and sell pressure, and exchange reserves have trended to multi-year lows (~14–15M ETH on exchanges), signaling sustained self-custody preference. The 100% circulating ratio eliminates cliff unlock risk from team or VC vesting, though the absence of a hard cap and potential issuance increases (e.g., if staking participation drops) temper the tokenomics score relative to capped-supply assets.
score_rationales.wyckoff: Wyckoff phase carried from last snapshot until the next daily indicators refresh.
score_rationales.adoption_activity: Ethereum commands ~68% of total DeFi TVL (~$45B on L1, ~$48B secured across 73 active rollups) and hosts 7.8M+ active DeFi users with 19% YoY growth; L2 throughput exceeds 10,000 TPS collectively and daily L2 transactions have surpassed mainnet, with record smart contract deployments in Q4 2025 — strong ecosystem breadth, though L1 TPS remains constrained at 15–30 and activity is increasingly bifurcated across L2s rather than concentrated on the base layer.
